entries.wording: ННВ створено. Очікуємо передачу вантажу до відділення SAT.
entries.note: The tracker's script shows it when the waybill exists but the cargo has not reached a SAT branch yet.
First step of the tracker page's progress bar, lit once the cargo is accepted at a SAT branch.
Second step of the tracker page's progress bar, lit while the cargo travels between terminals.
Third step of the tracker page's progress bar: arrived at the delivery branch; the script also lights it for a handover to a courier and for a delivery attempt.
Last step of the tracker page's progress bar, lit when the cargo is issued or delivered to the consignee.
History state in the sample reply of SAT's archived tracking API documentation.
History and current state in the sample reply of SAT's archived tracking API documentation: arrived at the issuing warehouse.
